name: document_uncentered_f2c_f3c_native_wearing_v1
source: Six public eight-channel 200 Hz users' training-domain trials, source-only F0v2 Rest thresholds, uncentered F2c log-Euclidean reference and explicit verified-ring F3c input contract.
target: Exact frozen four after-wearing domains and native trial identities of the parent. Validation users 15-17 and descriptive-final users 18-20.
classifier: Per user and arm, source-only native trial means, StandardScaler and balanced LogisticRegression C=1 max_iter=2000 random_state=20260924; target transform only.
decision: Compare each arm with matched frozen F0v2 and previous centered F2c/F3c scores on validation subjects; finals are descriptive. Do not promote from one wearing axis.
boundary: Ring topology is asserted only for this public electrode-shift ordering. These candidate formulas are not an independent cohort, own-device validation or automatic default.
